rule: never edited by hand; regenerate with the adapter and re-record provenance

query.filter: features with properties.time in [2019-07-06T00:00:00Z, 2019-07-07T00:00:00Z) and mag >= 3

all_day.ridgecrest-2019-07-06.geojson.notes: Cut of the committed ComCat Ridgecrest fixture, not a live all_day.geojson snapshot (that feed is a moving 24-hour window and is not reproducible). Feature properties are copied from the parent; the collection is re-serialised. Parent is M>=3.5, so this cut cannot contain 3.0<=M<3.5 events.

notes: real ComCat GeoJSON features; documented live feeds are all_hour.geojson, all_day.geojson, significant_month.geojson under https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/feed/v1.0/summary/
